content: pgTAP is Supabase's officially documented RLS-testing tool, but supabase test db (which runs pg_prove) always executes inside a Docker container regardless of --local/--linked/--db-url target, per CLI reference. Since this project's environment has no Docker (established in Phase 1 RESEARCH.md Environment Availability), pgTAP is not usable here without installing Docker Desktop; the established fallback is continuing Phase 1's pattern of hand-written integration tests (vitest + service-role admin client + anon client) against the live hosted project, which needs no local Postgres/Docker at all.
